CURRENT OWNER CONSTRAINT: canonical preview.html is a self-contained static HTML/CSS report; inline SVG and same-document fragment references are permitted, but JavaScript, inline handlers, automatic external resources, a server, a build, and installation are forbidden. It must open directly from the filesystem. Extends CodexHtml guarantees: concatenated span text is canonical text; a name resolves identically in text and graphic layers; no colour alone carries meaning. Per O4, HTML is a report: deterministic regeneration, text-graphic twin equality, receipts, visible missingness, and honest coverage are required; parse-render round-trip is not.
